svg.title: Who does what: the agent organization
svg.desc: Org chart of 9 agents. Orchestrator at the top; Product, Engineering, QA & Release, Growth, and Ops & Risk below it; Engineering delegates to Backend, Frontend, and DevOps sub-agents through the Task tool. Each agent lists its model, whether it has project memory, and its skills. Orchestrator: workflow-router, ship, status, decision-memo-writer, release-readiness-gate, ingest, system-maintenance, artifact-import, setup, upgrade-company-os, rapid-prototype, token-cost-ledger, conflict-resolver, weekly-review, retrospective. Product: icp-positioning, prd-writer, sprint-prioritizer, feedback-synthesizer, discovery-validation, ux-research, market-intelligence, customer-conversations. Engineering (Staff): architecture-draft, implementation-decomposer, code-review, conflict-resolver, ai-engineering, excalidraw. Backend: api-contract-designer, background-jobs, multi-tenancy, seed-data. Frontend: design-system, mobile-readiness, instrumentation, user-docs. DevOps: deployment-strategy, observability-baseline, feature-flags, dev-environment, resilience-testing. QA & Release: test-plan-generator, api-tester-playbook, release-readiness-gate, perf-benchmark-checklist, code-review, seed-data, dogfood, experiment-framework, test-intelligence. Growth: positioning-messaging, landing-page-copy, seo-topic-map, channel-playbook, activation-onboarding, email-lifecycle, content-engine, product-led-growth, gtm-sprint. Ops & Risk: threat-modeling, privacy-data-handling, compliance-readiness, pricing-unit-economics, tos-privacy-drafting, incident-response, support-operations, token-cost-ledger, security-posture.
svg.text: Who does what: the agent organization
9 agents. The Orchestrator routes work; each agent owns a set of skills.
opus / sonnet = the model the agent runs on. memory = keeps project memory across sessions.
Backend and DevOps work in parallel; Frontend waits for the API contract.
